title: Fluffy Blueberry Pancakes
description: Thick, soft pancakes bursting with blueberries.
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients together.
Mix milk, egg and butter, then fold into the dry mix.
Fold in the blueberries.
Cook ¼ cup scoops on a hot greased pan until bubbles form, flip, and cook 1 more minute.

title: Chickpea Coconut Curry
description: A creamy, one-pot vegan curry ready in 30 minutes.
steps: Sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Stir in curry powder for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk.
Simmer 20 minutes and finish with coriander. Serve with rice.

title: Molten Chocolate Lava Cakes
description: Individual cakes with a gooey chocolate centre.
steps: Melt chocolate and butter together.
Whisk eggs, yolks and sugar until pale.
Combine both mixtures and fold in the flour.
Pour into greased ramekins and bake at 220°C for 10–12 minutes.
Rest 1 minute, then flip onto a plate.

title: Classic Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant layered rice with spiced marinated chicken.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and masala for 1 hour.
Par-boil the rice with whole spices.
Cook the chicken until tender.
Layer rice over chicken with fried onions, herbs and saffron milk.
Seal and steam on low heat for 20 minutes.

title: Avocado Toast with Egg
description: Crunchy sourdough, smashed avocado and a jammy egg.
steps: Toast the bread.
Smash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Boil eggs for 6½ minutes, then peel.
Spread avocado on toast, top with halved eggs and chilli flakes.

title: Quinoa Buddha Bowl
description: Roasted veggies, quinoa and a lemon-tahini dressing.
steps: Cook the quinoa.
Roast sweet potato, broccoli and chickpeas at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice and water into a dressing.
Assemble bowls and drizzle with dressing.
